# Technical Writing for Data and AI Work

> Write the README, decision memo, experiment report and model card a data or AI project runs on, for a named reader, with every claim checked. SDAIA Academy course FND-AIC-106, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 10,247 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Writing for a reader](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/slides/day1.md): One reader, the bottom line first, and the documents a project needs before anyone else can use it; sessions: Write for one reader, READMEs, designs and decisions, The decision memo; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/slides/day1.html; about 5,073 tokens
- [Day 2: Evidence documents and writing with assistance](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/slides/day2.md): Reports and cards that state uncertainty, slices and limits, and an assistant whose every change is checked; sessions: Experiment reports and model cards, Writing with an assistant; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/slides/day2.html; about 3,663 tokens
- [Capstone: Documentation set review](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/slides/capstone.md): Each participant shows the set in four minutes, then answers four minutes of questions on its claims and its history; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/slides/capstone.html; about 1,106 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Bottom-line-first rewrite](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/labs/D1_1_bluf.md): Day 1, Session 1, 60 min; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/labs/D1_1_bluf.html
- [Lab 1.2: Peer-tested README](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/labs/D1_2_readme.md): Day 1, Session 2, 60 min; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/labs/D1_2_readme.html
- [Lab 1.3: Decision memo](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/labs/D1_3_memo.md): Day 1, Session 3, 60 min; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/labs/D1_3_memo.html
- [Lab 2.1: Experiment report and model card](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/labs/D2_1_report_card.md): Day 2, Session 1, 60 min; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/labs/D2_1_report_card.html
- [Lab 2.2: Unassisted draft against assisted revision](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/labs/D2_2_revision.md): Day 2, Session 2, 60 min; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-106/labs/D2_2_revision.html
